review.summary: The simple continuous curved road has been reconstructed as a forked Y-shaped slab with a deep side notch and inconsistent width. Cached raw decoder stage217 shows the same defect, so this is not introduced only by final simplification.

issues.problem: Invented branch and missing road area violate the unbranched curved reference.

review.summary: Second shape is a broad triangular/funnel slab tapering into a narrow stalk, not a constant-width curved road.

issues.problem: Missing curved strip and severe width mismatch make the segment unusable for the reference route.

review.summary: Third shape remains a strongly tapered/notched V-like slab, with a broad central body and narrow ends rather than an even-width curved road.

issues.problem: Major width inconsistency and missing road area; all three original shape attempts are exhausted.
